correctness.rationale: The smooth curve has genus four. Direct expansion gives the 4-by-4 Cartier coefficient matrix with off-diagonal blocks of equal determinant D, rank four or two. Correct p-inverse semilinear iteration gives M^(7)M, whose two rank-one blocks on D=0 share scalar E=1+(3a)^7w; this proves stable ranks 4,2,0. Exact lexicographic Gröbner basis of (D,E) has univariate P of degree 22 and 20 distinct roots; discriminant substitution is coprime to P. The standalone symbolic and GF49 verifiers were executed successfully.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Superspeciality requires Cartier rank zero and implies 7-rank zero, whereas this family has Cartier rank exactly two on its 20 rank-zero parameters. The genus-two quotient structure suggests even 7-rank but does not supply the printed elimination equation and exact smooth parameter count.
